alt: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 1 smart glasses and their white charging case resting on a surface, looking identical to regular Ray-Ban sunglasses with no visible camera or recording indicators
story: Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses were deliberately designed to be indistinguishable from regular sunglasses so people wouldn't feel judged wearing them; that exact design decision enabled users to secretly film strangers without detection, earning the glasses the nickname 'pervert glasses,' and now legitimate wearers are too scared to wear them in public — Instagram cracked down on covertly-shot videos from the glasses on July 28, 2026.
why_funny: The feature that was supposed to make the glasses socially acceptable — looking completely normal — is the same feature that made them socially radioactive.
